title: 第十章 同桌吃饭
slug: 民国我包国维黄埔一期
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

何教官走了过去，把钢笔给了包国维：“不错，精彩，这钢笔是你的了。”

“谢谢何教官。”

待何总教官走了后，好些个同学围了来：“国维，你可以啊，技压群雄。”

“了不起。把羡耘都给赢了。”

包国维自谦说道：“侥幸，只是运气好罢了。”

若不是用上了空间能力毁坏了他的木枪，这胜负且两说呢。

侯景如把地上断了的木枪捡起来看了一下，这实木木枪竟然给打断了，该是何等气力。比拼刺刀也这么多次了，可很少听说谁的木枪坏了的。

军校用来专门训练的木枪，那都是质量极好的，谁敢在这上面搞贪污中饱私囊，训练装备用一些伪劣产品。

“好大的力气，这可是优质硬木材料，竟然断了。包国维，你是如何办到的。”

即便不是在比拼刺刀的情况下，专门去进行劈砍，也不是那么能毁坏的。

包国维也略微解释了下：“我练过武术，会些气功，力气是大了一些。再用点巧劲，不是难事。”

在地上看到了一块砖头，直接捡了起来，先用空间能力把砖头给弄出一道深深的细小的裂缝，再朝砖上给来了一掌，砖头直接断裂。

“厉害，好功夫。”

“好！”

这一手再次赢得同学们的赞叹。如果这一掌往人脑袋上这么来一下，不得开了瓤。

包国维想着现在还需要借助空间能力，再多加训练，身体各方面力量什么的再加强些，纯靠自身能力应当也是能办到的。

何总教官又回了校长办公室。

操场的情况他也见到了，本来他以为胜者会在蒋羡耘和陈亘之间产生，没成想让包国维拔得头筹。

“胜者是？”

“校长，是包国维，就是您那个浙江乡党。”

“倒是有些出乎意料了，是个人才。”

军校中，不管是文的还是武的，没几个人能赢得了蒋羡耘。

这一回，包国维的名字再次在校长这里加深了些印象。

不少同学还在讨论着刚刚拼刺刀的情况。

Page (1/3)

Instructor He walked over and gave the pen to Bao Guowei: "Yes, wonderful, this pen is yours."

"Thank you, instructor He."

After Instructor He left, many students gathered around him and said, "Guowei, you can do it, you can beat the rest."

"Amazing. I won even Xianyun."

Bao Guowei said modestly: "It's a fluke. It's just good luck."

If he hadn't used his space ability to destroy his wooden gun, the outcome would have been debatable.

Hou Jingru picked up the broken wooden gun on the ground and looked at it. This solid wooden gun was actually broken. How powerful it must be.There have been so many bayonet competitions, but it is rare to hear that someone's wooden gun is broken.

The wooden guns used by military academies for special training are all of excellent quality. Who dares to engage in corruption and enrich themselves by using fake and inferior products for training equipment?

"It took so much effort. This is high-quality hardwood material, and it broke. Bao Guowei, how did you do it?"

Even if you are not competing with bayonets and are specifically engaged in chopping, they are not that destructible.

Bao Guowei also explained briefly: "I have practiced martial arts and know some qigong, so my strength is a bit stronger. It will not be difficult if I use a little more skill."

I saw a brick on the ground, so I picked it up directly. I first used my space ability to make a deep, small crack in the brick, and then I slapped the brick, causing the brick to break directly.

"Awesome, good work."

"Okay!"

This move once again won the admiration of the students.If this palm hits a person's head like this, it will not be broken.

Bao Guowei thought that he still needed to use his spatial ability, train more, and strengthen all aspects of his body. He should be able to do it purely by relying on his own abilities.

Instructor He returned to the principal's office again.

He also saw the situation on the playground. Originally, he thought the winner would be between Jiang Xianyun and Chen Gen, but he didn't expect Bao Guowei to come out on top.

"Who is the winner?"

"The principal is Bao Guowei, your Zhejiang Township Party member."

"It's a bit unexpected, he's a talent."

In the military academy, few people could win over Jiang Xianyun, regardless of whether they were literary or military.

This time, Bao Guowei's name once again made a deeper impression on the principal.

Many students are still discussing the bayonet fight just now.
